title: A Guest with Fangs
description: The transformation is complete. The condition is no longer a fever, a bottle, or a possibility: the Overlord is a vampire. Lestat has come to the Dark Tower because the newly changed sovereign has entered a subject Gnarl does not pretend to know through lived experience. Hear him out as a sovereign, not as a patient.
description_completed: Lestat has voluntarily remained at the Dark Tower as the Overlord's vampire adviser. He is not a Minion, not a replacement for Gnarl, and not part of formal Tower Restoration. His presence is narrative and contextual; Questlog does not require a permanently spawned Lestat entity.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

objectives.name: Hear Lestat's first advice after the transformation

rewards.name: Record Lestat's arrival at the Dark Tower
